correctness.rationale: For every 0.7<=h<=0.8, the boundary arclength centroid is S=(0,hs/(2(1+s))) and the continuous perimeter Weber functional is coercive and strictly convex, hence has a unique reflection-invariant minimizer. Differentiating the three edge-integrals at S yields exactly the RESULT.md transcendental G(h). An independently reconstructed SymPy derivative and 100 contiguous mpmath.iv outward interval enclosures gave a conservative strict lower derivative bound 0.09508>0.09; independent 55-digit evaluation gave G(0.7)=-0.0066459334627944..., G(0.8)=+0.0067152187453978... and root h=0.7465542709140345326.... Direct quadrature at h=0.7,0.75,0.8,sqrt(3) agrees to >50 decimal places. This is continuum certification on 100 covering intervals, not 100 point samples. Since the vertical derivative is increasing with site height, its sign reverses the Weber-versus-Spieker order across the unique root. Does not assert global uniqueness among all triangle shapes or outside [0.7,0.8].
